I've written the plan to `aiws/work/REQ-001/04-plan.yaml` and changed no other file. It has five tasks. Every TC in the test spec belongs to exactly one task: 43 in total (TC-1..TC-43), each listed individually.

| Task | Group | Files | TC | depends_on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 be: `PhoneNumbers` (trim/normalize/isValid) | BE-1 | 2 | TC-1..TC-10 | – |
| T2 be: `Customer.phone`, `insert(..., phone, status)`, `existsByPhoneAndStatus` | BE-2 | 5 | TC-11, TC-12 | – |
| T3 be: `create` with 3 parameters + POST/`CreateCustomerRequest`/`App` seed | BE-3 | 6 | TC-13..TC-32 | T1, T2 |
| T4 fe: `formatPhone` + "Điện thoại" column | FE-1 | 4 | TC-33..TC-41 | T3 |
| T5 fe: phone input + send `phone` | FE-2 | 3 | TC-42, TC-43 | T3 |

**Key decisions:**
- **Tasks follow the design's compile groups (BE-1..3, FE-1..2).** After each task the whole `be_test`/`fe_test` suite runs, so every intermediate state must compile and keep the old tests passing. I checked the call sites of `create`, `insert` and `new Customer(` with grep to confirm the split works.
- **BE comes before FE,** matching the deploy order in the design. T1 and T2 are independent of each other. T4 and T5 only need T3, not each other.
- **Each task's description spells out the rules the developer must not miss,** because they only see their own task. Examples: T2 must write `phone.equals(c.phone())`, not the reverse. T1 must not use `String.trim()`/`strip()`. T4 must format first and escape after.
- **T1 can use `@ParameterizedTest` + `@MethodSource`.** `pom.xml` uses the aggregate `junit-jupiter` artifact, so no new dependency is needed.

**For the reviewer:**
- **`CustomerService.java` is in both T2 and T3 on purpose.** In T2, `create` keeps 2 parameters and only calls `insert(..., null, CustomerStatus.ACTIVE)`. T3 switches to 3 parameters and fixes every call site in the same task. T3's description gives the exact line numbers of those call sites.
- **`src/api/customerApi.js` is deliberately not in T5's `allowed_files`,** because the design says not to change it. If the developer thinks it needs a change, they must write to `questions.md` and stop.
- **`index.html` and `main.js` (T5) have no unit test** (no DOM), so they need review or a manual run.
- **The `[CẦN XÁC NHẬN]` test data rows are unchanged:** VT in the middle of a string, NBSP and EM SPACE in TC-3/6/10/13/17/21.
- **The existing `customerTable.test.js` tests don't pin the header row or the number of `<td>` cells.** Adding the column won't break them.

**Verification:** Bash was denied, so I couldn't run a script to parse the YAML or check TC coverage. I checked by hand against `validatePlan` (`aiws/adapters/cli/src/validate.js`): TC count and uniqueness, `/` paths inside `source_paths`, no protected paths, at most 10 files per task, `type` values allowed, no dependency cycles. The orchestrator will run `validatePlan` again itself.
